name: Onora
description:
About This Game

In the midst of a sea of glowing dunes, unreal white monoliths pierce the skies of planet Onora. You emerge from a landing capsule — alone and disoriented — and mount a futuristic bike to reach these desert cathedrals. Beneath their arches, the sand gives way to lush biomes where the ruins of a forgotten civilization still linger.

Each sanctuary shelters living puzzles: bond with the local fauna to run along walls as a Gekko celeris, light up pathways as a Phasmylume, or smash through barriers as a Goliathus. These metamorphoses expand the ways you move and solve challenges.

The loop is simple: spot a glowing sanctuary, blaze a trail through the sandstorms, and activate runic totems that unveil memories and unlock new powers. As you gather fragments, the mystery of Onora’s connection to its creatures and the Ancients gradually unfolds.

Onora is a third-person puzzle exploration game blending open-world traversal with transformation-based puzzles. Every discovery redefines how you navigate — ride, climb, swim, or glide — weaving an environmental narrative where nature has reclaimed the remnants of a civilization that delved too deep. Will you be the one to reignite Onora’s spark?
short_desc: On Onora, cross the desert toward towering opal spires. Beneath their arches, greenery hides ruins and puzzles. Become a Gekko, Phasmylume, or Goliathus to solve enigmas, awaken totems, and uncover the secrets of the ancient Onorian civilization.
